title: Antigravity adapter
description: Tap Antigravity history: ~/.gemini/antigravity and antigravity-cli roots (conversations with protobuf user-turn payloads, conversation_summaries.db SQLite). Extract ALL part types. Reference: scanner-sentiment antigravity adapter, read-only.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Scope note: this adapter epic is the per-agent translation of Chapter 3: Importers / Change Data Capture (epic BOTSPY-e0bcfa, features/03_importers). It owns only this agent's side of the CDC pipeline — watching the source and emitting normalized records as they appear — not the pipeline mechanics, which live in Chapter 3. Parenting stays on initiative BOTSPY-65cc21 per board rules.

right_now_summary: The team is extracting Antigravity data, building fixtures, and testing parity across both source roots.
